repo_notes.content: crgx is the npx equivalent for the Rust ecosystem. It runs any crate binary instantly without cargo install by fetching pre-built binaries, caching them locally, and executing via exec(). Resolution chain: local cache → binstall metadata → GitHub Releases → QuickInstall → cargo build. The Rust source is in /src/, with modules for CLI parsing (cli.rs), crate registry (registry.rs), binary resolution (resolve/), download/extraction (download.rs), caching (cache.rs), and HTTP with retry logic (http.rs).
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Key usage: `crgx tokei .` runs tokei without installing. `crgx -y fossil-mcp` skips confirmation (needed for CI/MCP). `crgx tokei@14.0.0 .` pins an exact version cached forever. Bare names use 24h staleness. Network-resilient: 30s API timeout, 5min download timeout, automatic retries, offline fallback to cached binaries.
repo_notes.author: maintainer
